scope: Provider-free pre-authentication correlation and one-time reservation only; no external exchange permission, identity/session/grant issuer, raw-secret persistence or public route
review: Same-implementer semantic review plus delegated independent read-only engineering review; not actual provider or production acceptance
findings_resolved: Three private FORCE RLS sidecars bind exact current owned application/configuration revision, immutable S256 commitments and one-time redacted admission ledger
Dedicated actual preauth login and safe role flags/memberships are checked in port and definer; no API/runtime/lifecycle/linking role assumption, function access or direct table privileges
Migration prerequisite retains safe owner/API baseline including transitive owner-role membership rejection
Atomic begin has no legacy-only committed gap; duplicate begin returns no old or regenerated private material
Separate command and canonical provider/environment/client/code advisory namespaces serialize aliases; command/challenge/client-code uniqueness remains a backstop
Different callback commands and codes racing for one challenge produce one reservation; same callback replay and read-only reconciliation return only held correlation
Database wall time is rechecked after advisory/configuration/challenge waits and potentially blocking UNIQUE insertion; private expiry subtransaction rollback removes both reservation and consumption
Legacy consume is replaced append-only with unchanged signature/legacy behavior and excludes managed PKCE challenges; protected original fields, PKCE records and ledger are immutable
Actual COMMIT acknowledgement/release loss is uncertain and never returns fresh correlation; absent read-only reconciliation cannot create an admission
First five migration bytes and frozen v1 schemas remain unchanged; no provider call, key, callback configuration, authenticated HTTP route or production issuer added
remaining: Qualified browser transport and cookie/CSRF/origin/rate/cleanup controls
Private WorkOS broker with separately qualified durable pre-send/unknown-outcome handling and actual staging exchange
WorkOS issuer/JWKS/application verification and immutable provider-ID mapping
Audited identity/session issuance, refresh/logout, provisioning/SSO and hosted infrastructure
Merchant activation and production launch qualification; reservation correlation never authorizes a provider request
